name: kyro-pi-sprint-flow
description: Pi-oriented Kyro sprint orchestrator via executor/QA workers; follows Kyro next step

changes: Renamed from kyro-sprint-flow to kyro-pi-sprint-flow (Pi-oriented orchestrator)
Pi: before launching the QA worker, list enabledModels and wait for a user-picked certifier model
Pi: QA subagent must run with that model; silent .subagents.defaultModel is not a valid certifier
QA worker must return the kyro-qa output verbatim; no wrap, summary, or restyle
Orchestrator must present the QA worker final message to the user unchanged
Executor/Fix status is the full return contract, not a recap; store raw_output in flow state
Initial release: Kyro orchestrator skill that directs isolated executor, QA, and fix workers
Orchestrator never loads kyro-sprint-executor, kyro-task-context, or kyro-qa
Structured return contracts for executor and QA workers; flow state passed explicitly
User authorization gate before first QA; re-QA after fixes follows KYRO NEXT STEP
Fix Plan generated from QA findings; fix→QA loop capped at 3 rounds
State-guided routing via KYRO NEXT STEP rather than a hardcoded execute→QA→fix machine
